outcome: Taxonomic profiling (abundance of Bacteroides, Clostridium, Actinobacteria, Rothia, Proteobacteria, Streptococcus)
Functional potential of gut microbiota (KEGG pathways, LPS biosynthesis pathway activity, glycolytic activity)
cohort: The study included 45 preterm infants whose mothers were categorized based on preeclampsia status and prenatal Bifidobacterium supplementation during pregnancy.
finding: Maternal preeclampsia impaired early-life gut microbiota establishment in preterm infants, characterized by reduced diversity and dysbiosis, which was partially mitigated but not fully reversed by prenatal Bifidobacterium supplementation.
